description: TrustReceipt conformance test vectors. A verifier claiming TrustReceipt conformance must produce the exact expected outcome for all 10 vectors.

test_jwks.description: Use any Ed25519 key pair when running these vectors. The kid in each valid vector and in TC-007 must match the kid in your test JWK. TC-008 deliberately uses a mismatched kid.

failure_codes.schema_invalid: The payload does not conform to the TrustReceipt 1.0 schema (missing required field, bad enum, bad type, or unknown schema_version).
failure_codes.expired: The current time is after expires_at.
failure_codes.unknown_kid: The kid in the JWS header is not present in the verifier's JWKS.
failure_codes.signature_invalid: The JWS signature does not verify against the public key for the given kid.

vectors.description: Valid MCAP receipt with policy_decision=allow, two trust provider assertions (ClearSale fraud score + Mastercard AP agent trust), EU GDPR privacy classification, cart_hash and order_hash present, empty hash_chain_prev.

Valid x402 receipt with policy_decision=allow, payment_reference present (Stripe), single Stripe Radar trust assertion (score 0.92), no PII, OpenAI agent provider, permit2 and ERC-20 transfer artifacts.

Valid AP2 receipt with policy_decision=allow, three trust providers (ClearSale + Trulioo identity + NeuroID behavioural), consent_context present, hash_chain_prev linking to a prior receipt, Anthropic agent.

Valid MCP receipt with policy_decision=review (transaction under manual review, no payment_reference yet), contains_pii=true, EU jurisdiction, 90-day retention, GDPR consent scope, Trulioo identity assertion.
Valid ACP receipt with policy_decision=allow, Skyfire KYAPay assertion, hash_chain_prev present (audit continuity), one attachment (PDF evidence file), consent_context present.
Tampered payload: user_intent_hash is empty string (violates non-empty constraint) AND schema_version is '2.0' (unknown version). Verifier must reject at schema validation before signature check.
Expired receipt: issued_at=1700000000 (Nov 2023), expires_at=1700003600 (one hour later). Sign with a valid test key. Verifier must pass signature check and then reject on expiry.
kid='nonexistent-key-id-abc123' which does not exist in the test JWKS. Set the same kid in both the JWS header and payload field when building the test token. Verifier must fail key lookup.
Two required fields are absent: user_intent_hash (key does not exist, not null) and verification_methods (key does not exist). Verifier must reject at schema validation.
Two enum violations: protocol='INVALID_PROTOCOL' and policy_decision='maybe'. Neither value is in the allowed enum. Verifier must reject at schema validation.
